headline: Bengaluru Couple Shares Goa Move Costs
summary: A couple that left Bengaluru to start fresh in Goa has publicly broken down their expenses and financial planning. The details offer a practical look at the cost of relocating to the coastal state.

headline: Goa Cop Arrested for Minor's Assault
summary: A Goa police officer has been accused of sexually assaulting a minor girl multiple times inside a crime branch office. The incident has sparked outrage and immediate legal scrutiny.

headline: Goa Faces Bihar in Ranji Trophy
summary: Goa is scheduled to play against Bihar in Match 50 of the Ranji Trophy Elite 2026/27 season. The fixture is part of the ongoing domestic cricket tournament.

headline: New Vande Bharat Route Timetable Released
summary: The timetable for the new Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa has been officially released. Passengers can now check operational timings for the scenic route.

headline: AAP Announces 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra'
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has announced plans to launch a statewide 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' starting November 26. The protest march targets the ruling government over rising prices and corruption.

headline: Voter Deletion Data Questioned in Goa
summary: Queries have been raised regarding the specific numbers of Hindu, Christian, and Muslim voters whose names were deleted from electoral rolls in Goa. Transparency on the voter list revisions is being demanded.

headline: CM Inaugurates Konkani Music Convention
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant inaugurated the World Konkani Music Mega Convention in Mangaluru. He lauded the local community for their efforts in keeping the Konkani language alive.

headline: Army's Biten Singh Wins Ironman Goa
summary: Biten Singh of the Indian Army won the Ironman 70.3 Goa 2026 event. He successfully completed the grueling challenge while setting a new course record.

headline: Judge and Pilot Finish Ironman Goa
summary: A retired pilot and a Kerala High Court judge successfully completed the demanding Ironman 70.3 endurance race in Goa. Their participation highlighted determination across diverse professions.

headline: Annamalai Completes Ironman 70.3
summary: Politician K Annamalai successfully finished the Ironman 70.3 challenge in Goa. He later shared his grueling experience of completing the intense endurance event.

headline: GTDC Seeks Ghat Aarti Deferment
summary: The Goa Tourism Development Corporation has requested a deferment of its proposed Ghat Aarti initiative. Authorities are reviewing the timeline for the cultural tourism project.

headline: Goa Joins Guinness Bid at Konkani Meet
summary: Goa has joined a historic Guinness World Record attempt as the Konkani music convention commenced in Mangaluru. Performers and attendees from multiple regions are participating in the milestone event.

headline: Goa Dairy Holds Prices Despite Hike
summary: Goa Dairy has announced that it will maintain its current milk prices for now. This decision comes even as neighboring Karnataka has approved a price hike for dairy products.

headline: Faster Marriage Registration for Weddings
summary: Goa has introduced a new initiative to ensure faster marriage registration services for couples coming for destination weddings. The move aims to streamline bureaucratic processes for tourists.

headline: New Vande Bharat Offers Ghat Views
summary: The new Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express promises passengers scenic views of the Western Ghats during its long journey. The chair car service connects major southern hubs with the coastal state.

headline: Goa to Challenge ST Reservation Halt
summary: The Goa government has decided to approach the Supreme Court against a High Court order that stalled the Scheduled Tribe seat reservation process. The state aims to clear legal hurdles ahead of upcoming polls.

headline: Smart City Control Centre Under Fire
summary: Goa's Smart City control centre faced heavy criticism after failing to manage severe traffic chaos. Residents and officials questioned the operational readiness of the tech-driven traffic management system.

headline: Bondada Group Plans Rs 3,000 Cr Investment
summary: The Bondada Group has signed an MoU with the Goa government to invest Rs 3,000 crore in local solar and biogas projects. The renewable energy initiative aims to boost sustainable infrastructure in the state.

headline: Supreme Court Adjourns Tejpal Hearing
summary: The Supreme Court has adjourned the hearing on Tarun Tejpal's release until November 5. The Goa government strongly opposed any relief for the accused ahead of the festive season.

headline: Goa Moves SC Over ST Reservation
summary: The Goa government is officially moving the Supreme Court to resolve the ST seat reservation issue before the 2027 polls. The legal action follows a prior High Court order halting the reservation process.

headline: Goa Expands Tourism Through Sports
summary: Tourism Minister Rohan Khaunte stated that Goa is actively expanding its tourism footprint by hosting international sporting events. These high-profile events are designed to attract diverse global visitors.

headline: Strict Ban on Toxic Narkasur Effigies
summary: The Goa government has issued a strict warning against the use of plastic and toxic materials in Narkasur effigies ahead of the festival. Authorities have mandated eco-friendly practices for building the traditional figures.

headline: Sailor from Punjab Dies in Polem Accident
summary: A sailor hailing from Punjab tragically died in an accident in Polem, Goa. Local authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the fatal incident.

headline: Belagavi Runners Finish Goa Ironman
summary: A group of runners from Belagavi successfully completed the challenging Ironman event in Goa. Their successful finish added to the list of regional athletes conquering the grueling course.

headline: Comba Wells Inspection Cancellation
summary: The sudden cancellation of scheduled inspections for Comba wells has sparked widespread health fears among locals. Residents are concerned about water safety and the lack of official oversight.

headline: Deepak Shirodkar to Contest in 2027
summary: Politician Shirodkar Deepak has announced his intention to contest the Shiroda assembly seat in the 2027 elections. Preparations for his campaign in the constituency are already underway.

headline: Minister Plans Vidarbha Mahotsav
summary: Goa's PWD minister is planning to organize a Vidarbha Mahotsav to bolster cultural ties between Goa and the Vidarbha region. The cultural exchange aims to foster stronger interstate community relations.

headline: HC Seeks Employee Data for POSH Compliance
summary: The High Court has ordered every panchayat in Goa to submit an official employee count to check compliance with the POSH Act. The directive aims to ensure workplace safety and anti-harassment measures at the grassroots level.

headline: AAP Launches Anti-Inflation Yatra
summary: AAP leaders have officially launched the 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' in Goa, running from late November through December. The campaign focuses on criticizing the ruling government's handling of inflation and governance.

headline: Longest Chair Car Service to Goa
summary: The upcoming Yeshwantpur-Goa Vande Bharat Express is set to become the longest-duration and slowest chair car train service in India. Passengers can book the journey to experience extended views of the Western Ghats.

headline: Court Orders Relief for Fire Victims
summary: The Bombay High Court has ordered a compensation of Rs 20 lakh for each of the families affected by a fatal fire tragedy in Goa. The ruling holds the responsible parties liable for financial relief.

headline: Scooter Accident Claims Woman's Life
summary: A woman has tragically passed away days after sustaining injuries in a scooter accident in Mandrem. Police are reviewing the details of the mishap.

headline: CM Sawant Visits Kateelu Temple
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant visited the Kateelu Durga Parameshwari Temple and offered prayers during his official travels. The visit took place alongside his engagements in neighboring Karnataka.

headline: CAS Gives AIFF Five Months for Dispute
summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport has granted the AIFF a five-month window to finally conclude Anwar Ali's long-drawn transfer dispute. The ruling sets a strict deadline for resolving the football controversy.

headline: Goa Shipyard Bags Massive Navy Order
summary: Goa Shipyard Limited has secured a massive order valued at over Rs 53,866 crore from the Indian Navy. The landmark defense contract will significantly boost the shipyard's manufacturing operations.

headline: Scam Run from Luxury Goa Villa Busted
summary: Law enforcement has uncovered how a group of young men operated a multi-crore scam out of a luxury villa in Goa. Investigations revealed the sophisticated methods used by the accused from their coastal hideout.

headline: Goa to Honor Out-of-State Konkani Achievers
summary: CM Pramod Sawant announced that Goa will consider recognizing Konkani achievers residing outside the state for prestigious literary and cultural awards. The initiative seeks to honor global contributors to the language.

headline: Bomb Threat to Goa Courts is Hoax
summary: A recent bomb threat targeting courts in Goa has been officially confirmed as a hoax. Police and security forces thoroughly searched the premises following the anonymous alert.
